title: Measuring Human Value Expression in Social Media Texts: Calibrated LLM Annotation and Encoder Transfer
reasoning: The paper focuses on Schwartz’s theory of basic human values (e.g., Benevolence, Universalism, Tradition), which are foundational components of moral and ethical systems. It evaluates how LLMs interpret and operationalize these subjective value constructs and aims to align model outputs with human expert moral/ethical judgments.
